title: CoAP: add support for additional options
description:
This MR adds support for additional CoAP options that have been added to [IANA registry](https://www.iana.org/assignments/core-parameters/core-parameters.xhtml#table-option-numbers).

Most of the changes should be relatively straightforward. One possible issue might arise from reusing the Block1 and Block2 dissection code for the Q-Block1 and Q-Block2 options – I hope the way I did it is fine. Let me know if further adjustments should be needed here.

You add new header fields without creating them in COAP_COMMON_HF_LIST. This will give an error or a crash.

CoAP [RFC7252 section 12.2](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc7252#section-12.2) specify that _"The range of 2048..64999 is for all other options including private or vendor-specific ones"_, so you cannot assume option 2049 and 2053 are used for OCF Core specification. Dissection of this options must be made into a preference, default off.

I think section 12.2 of RFC 7252 only refers to the process of adding new options to the IANA registry. Options 2049 and 2053 might be vendor-specific, but they are part of the registry, so I think mentioning the OCF Core Specification should be fine/correct here, since it is the place where the semantics of the options are defined (see page 126 of the [specification document](https://openconnectivity.org/specs/OCF_Core_Specification.pdf)).

Since they are officially registered, I think there is no real need for adding a preference for dissecting them, as the registry prevents potential conflicts with other vendor-specific or privately used options. But I might be wrong here.

Right, I didn't look at the IANA registry.

When the CoAP spec has a defined range for vendor-specific and private options then they will be (I'm working with traces from such vendors) used without being registered with IANA. This is why I want a preference here.

After looking at the IANA registry I will change my mind and suggest a preference which can be turned on to show vendor-specific/private options as "Unknown" raw data. This is because I'm working with traces using such options, and I don't want dissection failures. Later I may add support for dissecting private options using Lua.

> After looking at the IANA registry I will change my mind and suggest a preference which can be turned on to show vendor-specific/private options as "Unknown" raw data.

That sounds good :)
And, because I need this preference I can also implement it.
